title: Is the glow over? Why matte lips are making a big comeback
summary: Matte is back when it comes to lip looks, driven by nostalgia and the revival of maximalist make-up. But these next-generation lip products are a long way from the drying formulas of the past, delivering skin care ingredients for hydration and blurring benefits, as well as comfortable textures
